profile.headline: Healthcare IT Technical Success Engineer, NeuroFeedback Certified Practitioner, Neuroscience & NLP Coaching, Advocate for Autism, Mind-Body Fitness & Texas BBQ
profile.summary:
Being raised in a family surrounded by healthcare workers, I'm proudly serving as a technical success engineer at uPerform, a Healthcare IT (SaaS) company, to help healthcare organizations empower their clinical staff with smarter, faster access to training and education. Our goal is to improve provider adoption, reduce burnout, and ultimately support better patient care through technology-enabled learning.

But when the workday ends, my deeper mission continues.

Outside the corporate space, I run a private practice with my nurse wife as a Certified Neurofeedback Therapist, NLP Coach, and Neuroscience-Based Wellness Transformation Coach—specializing in helping special needs school-aged children and their overwhelmed but determined parents transform their health, habits, and mindset.

My approach combines brain optimization tools like IASIS Micro Current Neurofeedback, neuroscience coaching, and practical habit change methods to help families unlock focus, emotional regulation, deeper connection, and long-term resilience—without shame, fluff, or one-size-fits-all advice.

I believe performance—whether in the hospital, at home, or in your own mind—isn't just about systems. It's about supporting the human behind the role.

Let’s connect if:
✅ You’re in healthcare tech or digital transformation
✅ You’re a parent of a child with special needs navigating stress, burnout, or big decisions
✅ You believe healing, growth, and leadership start from the inside out
